Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the MAP draft — we reviewed with procurement this morning and have two asks before we can commit to a start date: a) confirm the remaining approver ladder and exact signer window for our legal and procurement teams, and b) a deterministic kickoff date that accounts for our internal security review (they need 7 business days).

Attached are our redlines to the SOW and a short matrix showing internal approvers. Can you confirm who at Redwood will need to execute the final SOW (title/email) and whether your side needs any exec approvals for the agreed pricing/credit?

We'd like to propose a contractual signature window of Nov 23–25 (procurement availability) and a potential start date of Jan 4, 2027, assuming signatures are in place. If that window doesn't work, please propose alternatives this week so we can lock the MAP.

Attachments: BrightCart_redlines.docx, internal-approver-matrix.xlsx (referenced)

Best,

Ana — thanks and appreciated.

Quick answers up front:
- Final signer at Redwood for this SOW: Karthik Iyer, VP, Commercial (karthik@redwoodinference.com). He has delegated e-sign authority for deals <= $350k. Any discounts beyond the committed quote will need a one-off VP+ sign-off (we'll call that out).
- Exec approvals required: none beyond the VP for the currently negotiated terms.
- We can provide a DocuSign envelope and aim to have it routed the morning of Nov 23 PST. If BrightCart procurement can sign by end of Nov 25, Jan 4 kickoff looks good from our side.

Proposed MAP updates (high level):
1) Lock evaluation acceptance criteria: 95th percentile latency target, top-line throughput for pilot, and sample prompt set for regression checks — as discussed in the attachment.
2) Approval ladder: BrightCart legal -> BrightCart procurement -> Redwood commercial (Karthik) -> Redwood delivery ops (Laura) -> E-sign complete.
3) Signature window: Nov 23 09:00 PST through Nov 25 17:00 PST. If either side misses the window, auto-fallback plan: start date moves to Jan 11 and pilot queue is rescheduled.

Action items for Ana: confirm procurement signer availability for Nov 23–25 and provide the name/email for DocuSign routing.
Action items for Redwood (Laura/Camila): hold delivery capacity block Jan 4–15 and flag any infra constraints.

I'm attaching the SOW v3 with the redlines merged for your review.

Attachments: RDW_BrightCart_SOW_v3.pdf

--
Vivek Kulkarni

- On acceptance: please confirm the regression prompt set by Nov 26 so we can wire up monitoring & eval hooks.

2) Confirm that the security exception for IP sandboxing is documented in the appendix.

- Redwood will publish a DocuSign envelope for the SOW (RDW_BrightCart_SOW_v3.pdf) on Nov 23 at 09:00 PST.
- Signer order: BrightCart legal -> BrightCart procurement -> Redwood (Karthik Iyer) -> final confirmation to delivery team.
